runtime_dependency_repair.source: Existing local uv wheel cache; pure Python module plus package metadata copied, no numerical library replacement
runtime_dependency_repair.scope: Supplementary analysis runtime dependency; frozen model/source/statistical design unchanged. Failed initial execution retained.

interpretation_limits: 240 registered model runs include20 precisely matching Full reruns, not240 independent or necessarily different predictors; the remaining220 are not proven mutually distinct by this pairwise check.
All reported event intervals are conditional on fixed fitted models, this launched design and simulator settings; no optimizer-population or generator-physics uncertainty is supplied.
16-global,42-within-primary and336-joint group bands are separate families for each catalog; no joint C/D coverage claim.
Both catalogs evaluate the same fitted models; their repetition is new simulated-event evidence, not independent retraining evidence.

Positive group or global gains are not uniform improvement/calibration or downstream accuracy benefits. Event shares label regions with negative group averages, not the fraction of individual events made worse.
Coarse2 relative gain exceeds Hidden5, then gain declines at Coarse8 and Full5: this is nonmonotone across nested conditioner information, without causal mechanism identification.
Source selected-validation summaries are descriptive; all-validation replay verifies saved weights, not fresh-event generalization.

The earlier57 module tests omitted the real entry point's threadpoolctl dependency; the failed entry was retained, local3.7.0 added, and source replay was rerun before formal generation under the same deadline.
